name: Return to the Magistrate
summary: Return to the Magistrate concludes an urgent reconnaissance dispatch between the eastern border of Tirisfal Glades and the town of Brill. Having reported to Deathguard Linnea at the Bulwark, adventurers are sent back to deliver troubling news directly to Magistrate Sevren. The message confirms that the mindless minions of the Lich King continue to test the borders of the young Forsaken nation.

sections.title: Frontier Reports
sections.body: The eastern road out of Tirisfal Glades leads directly into the blighted ruins of the Western Plaguelands, where the Scourge holds devastating sway. To keep the undead hordes from spilling over into their newly claimed homeland, the Forsaken established the Bulwark—a fortified checkpoint garrisoned by grim sentries like Deathguard Linnea. After reviewing the defenses and learning what presses against the eastern gate, Linnea sends messengers racing back west along the King's Road toward Brill before enemy infiltrators can capitalize on any gaps.

sections.title: Sevren's Vow
sections.body: When Magistrate Sevren receives the dispatch in Brill, it confirms his worst fears: Scourge scouts are finding pathways around or through the frontline perimeter. For the Forsaken, every creeping ghoul and mindless skeleton is not merely a military nuisance, but a reminder of the enslavement they broke free from during the fall of Lordaeron. Sevren remains adamant that no matter how ceaseless the Lich King's onslaught becomes, the free undead will never surrender their newfound autonomy.

faq.q: Where does this report come from?
faq.answer: The report comes from Deathguard Linnea, stationed at the Bulwark along the eastern boundary of Tirisfal Glades. She guards the barricades separating Tirisfal from the Scourge-choked Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Sevren concerned about this news?
faq.answer: The dispatch informs Sevren that Scourge forces have managed to slip past the Bulwark's fortifications. For the Forsaken in Brill, enemy incursions threaten their fledgling towns and serve as a constant reminder of the Lich King's efforts to reclaim them.

Magistrate Sevren is the civil administrator of Brill. Operating out of the town hall, he oversees local defenses, infrastructure, and the mobilization of newly raised Forsaken citizens across central Tirisfal Glades.

The Bulwark is a fortified outpost constructed along the main thoroughfare between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. It serves as the primary barrier preventing Scourge incursions into Forsaken lands.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken hate the Scourge so much?
faq.answer: The Forsaken were once mindless thralls of the Scourge, slaughtered in life and raised in undeath to butcher their own kin. Having regained their free will, they despise the Lich King and fear losing their minds to his control once again.

faq.q: What path does this message travel?
faq.answer: Messengers travel west along the main road from the Bulwark, skirting the northern edge of the Balnir Farmstead and heading through central Tirisfal Glades until reaching the town center of Brill.

angles.text: Carrying intelligence from the Bulwark brings home the precarious reality of Forsaken freedom: the master you escaped still clawing at the doorstep of your new home.
The Horde's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms relies on the stability of Tirisfal Glades, making the Bulwark's defenses critical against the undead horrors of the Plaguelands.
